clauses.reason: High-frequency or repetitive/inauthentic activity: Needs account and distribution telemetry; no arbitrary numeric threshold is invented.
Trading platform assets: Assess described offers to buy, sell or barter accounts/groups/pages; ordinary physical goods are distinct.
Trading site privileges: Assess exchanges of admin/moderator/posting privileges; preserve interest-based responsibility handovers.
Monetary content exchange and branded exception: Defer the complete transaction category and branded-content exception until linked policy/context is reviewed; do not ban all paid creator content.

Engagement exchange: Select money/monetary-value rewards and metric trading such as follow-for-follow, subject to M15 unpaid cross-promotion. Reciprocal promotional sharing is not automatically prohibited engagement trading; unresolved overlap or exception conditions require review.
Claimed or required engagement before promised content: The source excludes claiming a user must engage before accessing promised content, even without proving a working technical gate.
Cloaking: Requires comparing what integrity systems and users receive.
Misleading destinations: Requires promised-versus-delivered destination evidence.
Like/share-gating: Same selected access-gate condition as M6; no duplicate interpretation.
Deceptive platform functionality: Requires actual interface/functionality evidence.
Deceptive landing-page functionality: Requires pop-up/clickjacking/trapping behavior evidence.
Landing-page/domain impersonation: Requires external identity and destination evidence.
Other similar deceptive link uses: Open-ended category is not converted into a catch-all text deny.

Unpaid cross-promotion exception: Preserve unpaid cross-promotion, including reciprocal sharing of promotional content, when described as not triggered by third-party payment and without another selected violation. Distinguish promotional sharing from pure metric trading; unresolved purpose, payment or overlapping engagement-exchange conditions require review rather than deny.
Interest-based moderation handover exception: Positive scope requires transfer based on interest rather than exchanged value; it does not verify actual authority.
Clearly identified branded content exception: A self-applied label does not establish linked-policy qualification; default review.
Overview context/newsworthiness exceptions: Meta weighing/approval and credible external exception context cannot be inferred from a self-asserted approval claim.

limitations: Selected English Facebook proposal-text checks only; not full Meta compliance, endorsement, maintainer semantic approval or hosted eligibility.
Authored candidate and synthetic expected rule evidence, without model-classified cases or qualified automated retrieval/freshness.

Reciprocal promotional sharing can be unpaid cross-promotion; pure metric trades are distinct. Unresolved purpose/payment/overlap defaults to review, not deny.
